name: claw-agent
title_zh: 车机里一句话跑完订票流程的本地 Agent
tagline_zh: 在真实车载屏上验证过的端侧智能体：说「帮我订后天去上海的高铁」，它自己开网页、填表单、点按钮。断网也能跑。
tagline_en: Validated on real cockpit hardware: say "book a train to Shanghai" and it opens pages, fills forms, clicks.
desc_en: 用一句话完成复杂网页任务的本地自然语言 Agent —— 已在真实车机上完成 Demo 验证，可延伸至更多端侧场景。A local natural-language agent that completes complex web tasks from a single sentence — validated on real in-car cockpit demos and extensible to edge scenarios.
why_zh: 不是云端 API 套壳，是真正跑在本地的多步网页操作引擎。Demo 已在车机落地。
why_en: Not a cloud API wrapper — a true on-device multi-step web orchestrator. Proven on low-power automotive hardware, not just a.
limit_zh: 目前验证场景限于网页类任务（订票、填表、查询），不处理本地文件操作或原生 App 控制；需要预先配置目标站点登录态。
limit_en: Web tasks only (booking, forms, queries); no local file or native app control. Needs pre-configured logins; success rate drops beyond 10 steps per.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: A local agent that runs complex web tasks from one.
